Chapter 4 - Call Appearances / Call Appearance Reference
Call Appearance Functions

Placing an Outgoing Call

You obtain a new call appearance structure using the TELSetupCall function. Once you do that, you can use a variety of functions to place the call, depending on the type of the outgoing call. The functions include
  • TELConnect (page 4-27) or TELDialDigits (page 4-28) for a simple outgoing call
  • TELConferencePrep (page 4-39) and TELConferenceEstablish (page 4-40) for a conference call
  • TELTransferPrep (page 4-35) and TELTransferEstablish (page 4-36) for a transferred call
  • TELRetrieveParkedCall (page 4-46) for retrieving a parked call
  • TELCallPickup (page 4-47) for picking up a call ringing at another terminal
  • TELVoiceMailAccess (page 4-48) for a call to a voice mail service
  • TELPaging (page 4-48) for a page
  • TELIntercom (page 4-49) for an intercom call
